title: Buildings index
description: Every real building of the campaign map the Location Editor can show and adopt, generated by tools/location-sync/export_buildings.py from the store (kurose.gpkg) through the map's own georeferencing, kept to buildings on the painted map's land. Read by module/blank-inheritance/scripts/core/buildings-index.mjs (decodeIndex). Regenerate by re-running that script; never hand-edit. design/location-editor.md section 13.

image.description: The campaign map's master image, [width, height] in pixels; every footprint is in this pixel space.

kinds.description: The building kinds (OSM building=*), sorted; a building names its kind by index into this list.

buildings.description: One row per building: [id, kindIndex, name or null, areaM2, outline]. The outline is the outer ring as the first vertex [x, y] followed by the step [dx, dy] to each next vertex, flat and in integer image pixels; the closing vertex is implied.
